summary: Explain claim lease renewal and event-based waiting to agents

schema.detail: No persisted data or vocabulary changes.

rules.detail: Lease duration, renewal, authority and ownership rules are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Human-readable work claim and work show output explain automatic renewal for a live driver-held claim. Other claims show the exact expiry and renewal command. The agent skill directs agents to existing waits, watches and message wakes instead of polling. When renewal ownership cannot be read, including over Fabric, successful work output retains neutral lease guidance instead of failing or asserting unmanaged ownership. JSON output is unchanged.

recovery.detail: A binary rollback restores the earlier text without a data migration.
